description.description:
A game developer by day, a miscreant by night, and a music producer hooked up to an IV.
Funky, junky, gunky, maybe a bit cyberpunky.

item.description: The paintbrush was angry at the color the artist chose to use.
item.title: Berdandy – Angry Paintbrush - EP

item.description: The best Las Vegas vacation I've had was the one where we left the city, and climbed Red Rock Canyon.
item.title: Berdandy – Glitching Past Red Rock - Single

item.description: I've been rewatching a lot of Cowboy Bebop lately. I think that may have filtered through from my subconscious.
item.title: Berdandy – Jet - Single

item.description: String theory is a theoretical physics framework where 0-dimensional particles are replaced by 1-dimensional strings. This is not that. But it does have string instruments.
item.title: Berdandy – String Theory - Single

item.description: When you find your person, the world just melts away, and you move as one.
item.title: Berdandy – Souls Beat Slow - Single

item.description: Melancholy and chill, something for a rainy day in the woods
item.title: Berdandy – Regrets - Single
